title: The intersection module-sheaf functor and its concrete Cech complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $P_F(W)$ by restricting $F$ to the over site $X.\mathrm{Opens}/W$ and applying the right adjoint of this restriction. Thus on an open $V$ its sections are $F(W\times V)$ and the $\mathcal O_X(V)$-action is restriction along the second projection. Restriction in the first variable gives the functor $P_F:X.\mathrm{Opens}^{\mathrm{op}}\to X.\mathrm{Modules}$. For any type $I$ in the universe of $X$ and family $U:I\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$, define $D=\check C^\bullet(U,P_F)$ using Mathlib cechComplexFunctor. Define $a:F\to D^0$ as the product of the over-site adjunction units $F\to P_F(\prod_l U(y(l)))$ over $y:\mathrm{Fin}(1)\to I$. These objects and morphisms are actual constructions, with no existence witness chosen.
